title: South Florida weekend guide: November nights
igCaption:
A few South Florida plans for Friday and Saturday night.
Nov. 6 and 7, South Florida, prices vary

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami, Sun Sentinel, Ones To Watch, WSVN 7News

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #PalmBeach

scenes.text: Looking for Friday and Saturday night plans? South Florida has concerts, food events, and one museum show already open.
Start with Miami’s weekend listings. Secret Miami has a November 6 to 8 guide with 23 things to do around the city.
scenes.caption: Start with Miami’s weekend listings. Secret Miami has a Nov. 6-8 guide with 23 things to do around the city.

scenes.text: In Broward, Ones To Watch has a November concert guide for Fort Lauderdale. It also rounds up 13 concerts in the Southeast this month.
scenes.caption: In Broward, Ones To Watch has a November concert guide for Fort Lauderdale. It also rounds up 13 concerts in the Southeast this month.

scenes.text: Sun Sentinel’s November roundup points to Beer B Que Music Festival, with Kodak Black and Rick Ross on the bill. At Beer B Que, open NEAR and see who else showed up.
scenes.caption: Sun Sentinel’s November roundup points to Beer B Que Music Festival, with Kodak Black and Rick Ross on the bill. At Beer B Que, open NEAR and see who else showed up.

scenes.text: For a quieter stop, Morikami Museum in Delray Beach has Naoko Fukumaru’s Mending Cracks in Time. It opened October 17 and runs through February 28, 2027. Adult admission is $18.

scenes.text: Which one are you doing this weekend, Miami or Broward? The same way you can spend a whole night in Miami and only realize later who was рядом? NEAR shows you the people you crossed paths with.
